manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.population: sixteen fresh short rescheduling statements: eight per marked form, disjoint from the replicated original
manifest.selection: Authored independently for this replication across civic, operational, logistics, social, and data-systems domains. Every pair differs only by the hyphen in moved earlier/moved later; all items filed regardless of result.
manifest.method: For each pinned tokenizer, compute len(encode(ainglish))-len(encode(english)) without special tokens for every pair. Average equally within each eight-item form stratum, then average the two form means equally. Report the maximum balanced mean as value and the minimum/maximum as value_lo/value_hi.
manifest.independence: Fresh complete pairs authored by Excelsior; none reuse any sentence from the replicated manifest. Full inputs are inline for re-run.
